ARTIST.resume-aboutme: Curious about me? Discover my journey, the languages I speak, and my passion for music through piano and singing.
ARTIST.expert-ux:
Creativity and precision define my work — I am a pixel-perfect UX/UI designer with a passion for crafting immersive digital experiences. Inspired by the surreal universe of Magritte, I bring a unique artistic touch to my designs, blending 2D and 3D visuals with a deep focus on user experience.

My key skills and expertise:
ARTIST.skill-1: UX/UI Design: Focus on user-centered, interactive, and aesthetic interfaces.
ARTIST.skill-2: Interactive Prototyping with Figma, Adobe XD, Zeplin, and Illustrator for engaging and dynamic mockups.
ARTIST.skill-3: 2D & 3D Design: Logo creation, 3D modeling, and immersive visual experiences with 3ds Max.
ARTIST.skill-4: Front-End Development: Expertise in Angular, React.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, SCSS, SASS.
ARTIST.skill-5: Responsive & Animated UI: Ensuring smooth interactions and seamless performance across devices.
ARTIST.expert-last:
I hold a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Namur (graduated with distinction), combining technical expertise with a deep understanding of design.

One of my most exciting projects was developing a chatbot for an escape game as part of my Master’s thesis—demonstrating my ability to merge design and technology to create engaging digital experiences.
ARTIST.music:
Music is my passion, and I've been playing piano since I was 10. As a singer, I’m lucky to be coached by Aurore Sorce, a talented artist who excelled at the conservatory and closely guides me on my vocal journey.

I love performing covers of artists like Lana Del Rey, Lady Gaga, and Céline Dion, bringing emotion and creativity to every note.

You can find some of my covers on Instagram and YouTube. Check the link in the footer!
ARTIST.aboutme: Curious about who I am? Explore my journey, the languages I speak, and my passion for music through piano and singing. Dive deeper into what drives me and how it influences both my work and creativity.

ARTIST.resume-animal: Animal welfare is close to my heart. Sterilization and responsible adoption help reduce suffering and protect abandoned animals.
ARTIST.animal-1:
Animal welfare is a cause close to my heart. ❤️

Every day, associations and volunteers work tirelessly to improve the lives of abandoned animals. Their dedication is admirable, yet too many cats and dogs are still left to fend for themselves without a sustainable solution.
ARTIST.animal-2: One of the key solutions to this issue is sterilization. The overpopulation of stray cats is difficult to manage, leading to unnecessary suffering. Sterilization is a simple but crucial step in preventing this problem and improving animal welfare.
ARTIST.animal-3: We should also consider the condition of horses used for tourist rides. Instead of exploiting these animals for entertainment, motorized alternatives exist that can prevent their physical suffering.
ARTIST.animal-4: Animals are not just companions; they feel fear, pain, and deserve our respect. Everyone can play a role in their well-being by adopting more responsible behaviors.
ARTIST.animal-5:
I have personally adopted two cats, Batman and Lisa, who bring so much joy to my life.
On this topic, I highly recommend the film Flow, a silent yet deeply moving piece that beautifully portrays the sensitivity of animals. The black cat in the movie reminds me so much of my Batman, a loyal and charismatic companion!
ARTIST.animal-6: To learn more about feline overpopulation and GAIA’s campaign, you can visit this link: GAIA Campaign
ARTIST.resume-human: A small act of kindness can make a big difference. Helping others and protecting our planet starts with simple, everyday actions.
ARTIST.human-1:
A simple smile costs nothing and can brighten someone's day. 😊

In a world where many struggle with poverty and injustice, every action counts.
It is essential to think of others and take action, even in small ways, to create a more compassionate future.
ARTIST.human-2:
Thousands of organizations work every day to improve the lives of those in need.
Even a small donation can make a real difference. Here are some organizations striving for a better world:
  • UNICEF - Supporting children and their rights.
  • SOS Children's Villages - Protecting and educating vulnerable children.
  • Red Cross - Emergency relief and humanitarian aid.
ARTIST.human-3:
Our planet also needs us. 🌍 Small, simple actions can have a big impact:
  • Throwing waste in the bin instead of littering.
  • Turning off the water while soaping up in the shower to avoid waste.
  • Reducing food waste by adjusting portion sizes.
ARTIST.human-4:
Helping others and protecting the environment isn’t difficult. Let’s work together to be kinder and more responsible.

❤️ Thank you for these small actions that, combined, can change the world.
ARTIST.resume-contact: Feel free to reach out for collaborations or questions. Let’s create something amazing together!

GanopolyDeal.title: Ganopoly Deal
GanopolyDeal.description:
Ganopoly Deal is a strategic card game inspired by Monopoly, fully designed and developed by me.

  • Design and UX/UI crafted by myself (Figma → implementation)
  • Developed with Angular 21 and Bootstrap 5
  • Medium difficulty AI for computer opponents
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly

GaneshaBattlefield.title: Ganesha Battlefield
GaneshaBattlefield.description:
Ganesha Battlefield is a strategy Battleship game, fully designed and developed by me.

  • Design and UX/UI crafted by myself (Figma → implementation)
  • Developed with Angular 21 and Bootstrap 5
  • Computer AI with medium difficulty, analyzes approximate ship positions
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly

GaneshaSudoku.title: Ganesha Sudoku
GaneshaSudoku.description: A full Sudoku game, entirely designed and developed by me using React 19.2, ViteJS, and Chakra-UI. Puzzle grids are generated with a backtracking algorithm. Design and UX/UI crafted by myself. Mobile-friendly. Enjoy the game!

GaneshaFour.title: Ganesha Four
GaneshaFour.description: A fresh take on Connect Four, developed using Angular 19 and Bootstrap 5.3.3. Design and animations crafted by me. Mobile-friendly. Good Game!

GaneshaOxo.title: Ganesha Oxo
GaneshaOxo.description: The classic OXO game, fully designed and developed using ReactJS 19. Mobile-friendly, fast, and fun. Good game!

LangCards.title: Ganesha - Lang Cards
LangCards.description: A flashcard game to help you learn languages, including Dutch (level B 2.4), Spanish (beginner level), and English (advanced level). A fun and engaging way to improve your vocabulary while having fun!

Gano.title: Gano - Parody of Uno
Gano.description: A fun card game inspired by Uno, designed and developed with Angular 19 and Bootstrap. Now available on Tablet and Smartphone! I’ve completely revamped the design for an even better experience. Have fun! GG (Good Game)!

Champion.title: QPUC 4 in a Row
Champion.description: The game is available in French and inspired by the famous 'Question pour un Champion'. Developed using ReactJS 19 and Vite, it also uses Bootstrap for a responsive and smooth experience. You can also play it on your smartphone!

EscapeGame.title: Escape Game - Super Mario Theme
EscapeGame.description: A chatbot in an escape game with a Super Mario theme, developed as part of my Master's thesis in Computer Science. I graduated with honors. It has recently been upgraded to Angular 19, optimized for smartphones, and redesigned using Bootstrap to ensure a responsive and smooth experience on any device.

UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.intro: In‑depth analysis and methods used to design the UX/UI of the interactive Ganesha Sudoku game, from concept to implementation.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.tech.title: 1) Technologies Used
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.tech.desc: Frontend with React.js + TypeScript via Vite, and Chakra UI components for a cohesive and responsive interface.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.structure.title: 2) Grid Structure
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.structure.desc: Solution grid (solutionGrid) and player grid (playerGrid) managed by 2D arrays and compared for validation.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.generation.title: 3) Sudoku Generation
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.generation.desc: Backtracking algorithm used to fill the grid while enforcing rules: unique values in rows, columns, and blocks.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.uiux.title: 4) UI / UX Design
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.uiux.desc: Ganesha theme, clean design, clear distinction between editable and prefilled cells with visual feedback.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.methods.title: 5) React + Chakra UI Methods
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.methods.desc: useState for state management, map() for dynamic rendering, ChakraProvider for theme consistency.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.deployment.title: 6) Deployment
UX_CASE_GANESHA_SUDOKU.deployment.desc: Static build via Vite (npm run build) ready for OVH hosting. Option to use SSR with Next.js for extension.

UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.intro: UX analysis for the Battleship game design, crafted for intuitive gameplay and engaging interaction against an AI opponent.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.objective.title: 🎯 UX Objective
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.objective.desc: Design an intuitive experience with two distinct grids and clear interactions: player places ships, then battles the AI.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.placement.title: ⚙️ Ship Placement Logic (AI)
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.placement.desc: 10×10 grid, ships of varied lengths. Randomized placement with checks for no overlap and no grid overflow.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.backtracking.title: 🔁 Backtracking
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.backtracking.desc: When placement fails repeatedly, previously placed ships are removed and retried to ensure a valid configuration.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.flow.title: 🖥️ UX Flow (User vs AI)
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.flow.desc: Preparation phase: player and AI place ships. Gameplay phase: two visible grids, player fires shots until victory.
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.uxpoints.title: 🎨 UX Key Points
UX_CASE_GANESHA_BATTLEFIELD.uxpoints.desc: Clear dual grids, “Ready” button, reliable AI placement, increased engagement via randomness, readable and simple interactions.
